free_tier.stated: 16 GB free with any QNAP ID, no trial period, no file-size minimum. Paid starts $0.99/month; 1 TB was $4.99/month during beta.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: No data transmission costs. 'Data transmission is completely free', stated repeatedly and used as the explicit differentiator against S3/Azure/GCP.

tooling: QNAP-only API and Hybrid Backup Sync / HybridMount. No rclone backend, no public S3 or WebDAV endpoint. Programmatic access is effectively gated behind QNAP firmware. One subscription plan per QNAP ID per region, which forecloses stacking on a single account.
chaining: Proprietary cloud storage service requires QNAP NAS hardware for access without public REST API endpoints.
limits_note: Per-unit: 16 GB free; one plan per region per QNAP ID. Deliberately unshardable.
reliability_note: Requires QNAP hardware or at least the QNAP account ecosystem for write access; the API is not a general object store.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
